author: Kevin Wang (KevinChunye)
method: C++20 PathFinder negotiation (integer, goal-directed bucket-queue searches; exact A* for the initial routing) + exact per-net shortest-path-tree reroute with random equal-delay ties + large-neighbourhood search with negotiated group repair (integer goal-directed searches, exact trees at commit), threshold acceptance from 8 cooling linearly to 0, kicks and return to best; 4 threads adopting the best every 600 s; designs: 3600 s per case; from scratch
